caption: five steps to start the day right #usahealth #wellness #healthybodyhealthymind #wellnessjourney #mentalhealth
transcript: The way you start your day is not serving you dough. These five simple practices will. First, leave your bed with awareness. Feel your feet on the floor. Your body remembers stillness before your mind does. Start there. Second, drink water slowly. Taste it. Not coffee yet. Coffee wakes the mind. Water wakes the body. Let the body go first. Third, find stillness. Look out a window. Watch the light. No phone. The first thing you look at becomes the lens for your whole day. Choose something quiet. Fourth, move your body gently. Stretch your arms. Walk across the room. Feel your shoulders soften. You are not exercising. You are arriving. Fifth, choose one small task. Empty the kettle. Wipe a counter. One small completion. Before the day demands a hundred more. It teaches your mind. I finish what I start. Do these five things. Your morning becomes your own again. Not a race. A beginning. Save this. Tomorrow morning, begin here.
